desc:
Fly. Melt steel with your eyes. Drop a whole city block.

You are the most wanted Super alive. Every building you level raises your wanted level — and the army answers. Tanks. Gunships. Mechs. Rival Supers hunting you at 55, 75 and 90.

Reach wanted level 99 and you win. Or keep going. The game is endless.

• Flight, heat-vision lasers, ground slams and chest blasts
• A real city that collapses properly when you break it
• Spend your bounty mid-run to upgrade your powers
• Play solo or bring a friend

How long can you last?

FLY. BLAST. DESTROY. 💥🦸🏆
#Destruction,Superhero,Simulator,Laser,City
